title: Knowing where the money goes
label: Clearly identified as an education edition, never as news.
facts: No statistics; arithmetic illustrations only, with assumptions stated.

captions.facebook:
FINANCIAL EDUCATION · Education edition

Knowing where the money goes

Most households know their big bills. Fewer know the total of the small ones.

Tracking every expense for one month, without judging it, often shows patterns: subscriptions, takeaway, fees.

The aim is awareness, not guilt. You cannot plan around costs you cannot see.

Awareness built on your existing income is the first step in any long-term plan.

Learn. Understand. Stay Informed.
